title: Head of SDR Operations (Senior, Full-Time, Remote, USD)
description:
$3,000 - $4,500/month USD + performance bonus. Paid twice monthly.



I am Henry, founder of Alba Talent (
), a UK-registered Revenue Architecture firm. We place trained cold callers with B2B companies across the US and UK. Our callers are powered by AI coaching, a proprietary certification platform, and a tech stack most agencies will not build for another five years.



Right now we have 3 clients, 6 callers, and infrastructure built for 50 clients and 200+ reps. The tech is ready. The systems are ready. What I need is the person who has DONE THIS BEFORE at scale. Someone who has managed 50+ SDRs, built the SOPs from zero, and knows exactly what breaks when a cold calling operation goes from a handful of reps to hundreds.



You are not a VA. You are not an assistant. You are the Head of SDR Operations for a company scaling from 3 clients to 30 in the next 12 months. You will own everything between "client signs the contract" and "meetings land on their calendar."



If you have scaled outbound SDR teams before (real cold calling, not inbound customer service) and you want a role where you run the show, keep reading.



---



WHAT YOU WILL OWN (Day 1)



1. THE DIALER. Configure, manage, and troubleshoot Salesfinity parallel dialer instances for each client. Create per-client workspaces, upload contact lists, manage caller seat assignments, handle timezone windowing and DNC scrubbing. If you have administered Salesfinity, Orum, Five9, Nooks, ConnectAndSell, or PhoneBurner at ADMIN level (not user level), you know what this requires. This is 30-40% of your week.



2. THE DATA. We burn 18,000 data credits per day across two platforms. Zero credits go unused. Ever. You will build daily cold calling lists, run ICP-filtered searches, split contacts into 1,500-record chunks sorted by phone quality score, and upload to our rep locker. If you have worked with Apollo, ZoomInfo, Seamless AI, Cognism, or similar B2B data platforms, you know the workflow.



3. THE CALLERS. Manage a team of 6 cold callers scaling to 50+. Daily dial accountability, connect rate tracking, disposition review, coaching on recordings, morning standups, EOD reports. You set the standard. You hold the line. When someone's numbers drop, you diagnose whether it is a bad list, bad script, bad delivery, or bad timezone, and you fix it that day. Not next week.



4. THE CRM. Own our CRM configuration: deal stages, lead attribution, caller performance dashboards, disposition mapping from Salesfinity. Salesforce experience translates directly here. If you have been a CRM admin (schema changes, workflow automation, API integrations), this is your lane.



5. THE CLIENTS. Weekly performance reports, lead quality conversations, ICP targeting adjustments, expectation management. You are the operational face of Alba Talent to our clients. When a client asks "why did my caller book a meeting with the wrong company?" you own the answer AND the fix.



6. THE HIRING PIPELINE. Source new callers, run them through our AI voice certification gauntlet (90% pass threshold), prep them in our Lion's Cage (15 hard/nightmare practice calls), and get them dialer-ready on day one. You build this team, not just manage it.



7. THE SOPs. Build the operational playbooks that let us scale from 6 callers to 60 without chaos. Script deployment per client. Onboarding runbooks. QA processes for list quality. Escalation frameworks for underperformance. If it needs a system, you build the system.



8. THE METRIC THAT MATTERS. Revenue per caller per month. That is the ONE number. Everything you do ladders up to it: list quality drives connect rates, connect rates drive meetings, meetings drive revenue. You own the weekly ops dashboard tracking this across all clients.



---



WHO YOU ARE



NON-NEGOTIABLES:

- 5+ years managing outbound SDR or cold calling teams (not inbound customer service queues)

- You have managed 50+ reps. Not 5. Not 15. Fifty or more, across multiple clients or campaigns. You know what breaks at scale and how to prevent it

- Hands-on parallel dialer administration at ADMIN level (Salesfinity, Orum, Five9, Nooks, ConnectAndSell, PhoneBurner, or equivalent). User-level experience is not sufficient

- CRM administration experience. Salesforce is the gold standard; HubSpot, Pipedrive, or Attio at admin level also qualifies. Schema changes, automation, not just data entry

- Experience with B2B data/enrichment platforms (Apollo, ZoomInfo, Seamless AI, Cognism, Lusha, or similar)

- You have BUILT SOPs, training programs, and operational playbooks from scratch. Not followed someone else's

- You are a salesperson yourself. You can pick up the phone, cold call a CEO, and book a meeting. You lead from the front, not from behind a spreadsheet

- Native or near-native English. You will communicate directly with US and UK clients. Clarity, confidence, and professionalism are what matter

- Available to work US business hours. Core overlap required: 9am-5pm EST (9pm-5am Manila time). If you are not comfortable working a night shift PH time, this is not the right fit



WHAT MAKES YOU DANGEROUS:

- You have run cold calling operations for a BPO, agency, or outsourcing company that placed callers with multiple clients simultaneously. This is the exact job

- You can open your laptop right now and show me a dialer admin dashboard you personally configured

- You have managed remote teams across countries and timezones. You know the coaching adaptations, the async standup formats, the accountability rhythms that make distributed teams perform

- You have improved connect rates or meeting conversion rates with specific before/after numbers. "I took connect rates from 2.8% to 4.1% by switching to local presence dialing." That sentence is worth more than any certification

- You reference cold calling frameworks by name: Gong research, 30 Minutes to President's Club, Josh Braun, Belal Batrawy. You are a student of the craft

- You have scaled a team from under 10 to over 50. You know the difference between managing people and building a machine



INSTANT DISQUALIFIERS:

- Your experience is managing inbound customer service, telco billing, or tech support queues. Different industry entirely

- You describe yourself as "strategic" but cannot name a specific process you built and ran daily. This role is 80% execution, 20% strategy

- You have never touched a B2B data platform. Building contact lists is a daily core function

- You cannot rattle off cold calling KPI benchmarks fro
mory: dials/day, connect rate, meetings/month, cost-per-appointment



---



WHAT YOU GET



CAREER TRAJECTORY: You are joining as the FIRST operations hire. Employee #1 in the operations department of a company scaling from 3 to 30+ clients in 12 months. The path: Head of Ops (solo, 3-10 clients) to VP Operations (with a team under you, 10-30 clients) to C-level if you earn it. This trajectory does not exist at a BPO regardless of tenure.



THE TECH STACK: You will work with AI-powered cold calling tools that most companies will not have for years. AI certification gauntlet, AI coaching personas, automated onboarding, 29-plugin 
 operations bot, custom course platform, data enrichment waterfalls. This is resume gold that no traditional call center can offer.



FOUNDER ACCESS: You report directly to me. Not to a middle manager, not to a team lead who reports to a director. Direct access to the founder, direct input on strategy, direct impact on the company.



COMPENSATION: $3,000 - $4,500/month USD depending on experience, paid twice monthly. No net-30 games. No "when the client pays."



PERFORMANCE BONUS: $500 - $1,000/month tied to tea
eting targets across all clients (10 meetings per caller per month). Hit the number, get the bonus.



STABILITY: Alba Talent is a UK-registered company with active clients, live revenue, and production infrastructure (custom course platform, AI certification tools, operational 
 with 29 plugins, client portal). This is not a 3-month experiment.



---



HOW THIS WORKS



Step 1: 2-Week Paid Trial. You work alongside me for 2 weeks at full pay. You see the systems, meet the team, do the work. If it is not the right fit, you walk away with 2 weeks of USD salary and zero hard feelings. If it IS the right fit, we lock in the full role.



Step 2:
Day Ramp.

Day 30: You run morning list builds and dialer admin solo. I am not touching it.

Day 60: You own the full daily ops cycle (lists, dialer, callers, client reports) without me looking over your shoulder.

Day 90: I have not logged into Salesfinity in 2 weeks. You ARE the operations layer.



Step 3: Scale. We go from 3 clients to 10, then 20, then 30. You hire junior ops staff under you. You become the person who built Alba Talent's operational backbone from the ground up.



---



This is a single role. When it is filled, it is filled.



Applications close July 6, 2026. I am taking 5 discovery calls this round.



---



TO APPLY:



Send me a message with:



1. Your experience managing outbound SDR/cold calling teams. How many reps, what dialer, what clients, what results. Be specific. Numbers matter.



2. A screenshot or description of a dialer admin dashboard you personally configured. Not your company's. Yours.



3. One specific cold calling KPI you improved and how. Before/after numbers. What you changed. Why it worked.



4. Your salary expectation in USD/month.



5. Confirm you can work US business hours (9pm-5am Manila time).



If you have been doing exactly this work for the last 5-10 years at a fraction of this pay, you are the person I am looking for.



Henry Williams

Founder, Alba Talent

 or similar e-commerce financial intelligence tools

title: Personal Injury Prelitigation Client Advocate / Case Manage
description:
# r – Remote



Experience Required:2–3 years minimum in personal injury prelitigation case management

Compensation: Based on experience



About the Role



We are a personal injury law firm seeking an experienced Prelitigation Client Advocate, often referred to as a case manager at personal injury firms, to manage personal injury claims from intake through settlement preparation.



This is not an entry-level position. We are looking for someone who already understands the prelitigation personal injury process, including client communication, insurance claims, medical treatment tracking, records and bills, liens, property damage, case updates, and preparing cases for settlement review.



The ideal candidate has prior experience working with a U.S.-based personal injury law firm and can confidently manage a prelitigation caseload with minimal training.



Primary Responsibilities



The Client Advocate will assist with personal injury prelitigation matters, including:



Client Communication and Case Management



Communicate regularly with clients regarding case status, treatment, property damage, insurance issues, and next steps.



Maintain consistent client contact and document all communications.



Explain the general prelitigation process to clients in a professional and client-friendly manner.



Follow up with clients regarding treatment status, provider information, lost wages, photos, documents, and other case-related needs.



Identify client concerns early and escalate issues to management or attorneys when needed.



Insurance Claims Handling



Open and monitor bodily injury, UM/UIM, MedPay, and property damage claims.



Communicate with insurance adjusters regarding claim status, coverage, liability, property damage, and settlement-related issues.



Request and track insurance coverage information, declarations pages, policy limits, claim numbers, and adjuster contact information.



Monitor adverse insurance decisions, coverage issues, delays, and claim problems.



Medical Treatment, Records, and Bills



Track client medical treatment from the beginning of the case through discharge.



Confirm providers, treatment dates, referrals, imaging, procedures, and ongoing care.



Request, collect, review, and organize medical records and bills.



Follow up with medical providers, records departments, billing offices, and third-party vendors.



Identify missing records, missing bills, gaps in treatment, and incomplete provider information.



Liens, Balances, and Health Insurance



Identify potential medical liens, letters of protection, health insurance claims, Medicare, Medicaid, AHCCCS, ERISA, workers’ compensation, and other reimbursement issues.



Track balances and lien information throughout the case.



Assist with requesting updated balances, lien confirmations, and final payoff information.



Maintain accurate notes regarding lien status and unresolved balance issues.



Property Damage and Other Damages



Assist clients with property damage issues, total loss claims, rental issues, vehicle repairs, diminished value, and related documentation.



Collect wage loss documentation, photos, out-of-pocket expenses, and other damages evidence.



Help ensure the file contains the information needed to evaluate damages before settlement review.



Case Organization and File Management



Upload, organize, label, and maintain case documents in the firm’s case management system.



Keep medical records, bills, insurance documents, correspondence, photos, wage loss documents, and settlement materials organized.



Maintain accurate case notes, tasks, deadlines, and follow-up reminders.



Ensure files are complete and ready for attorney review when needed.



Settlement Preparation



Assist with preparing cases for settlement review.



Confirm that treatment is complete or that the case is ready for settlement evaluation.



Help gather the documents and information needed for settlement opportunities, demands, or attorney review.



Prepare summaries, treatment timelines, provider lists, damages information, and other case materials as needed.



Proactively identify missing items before a case is moved toward settlement.



General Prelitigation Support



Help move cases forward proactively from intake through settlement.



Follow firm procedures and maintain high attention to detail.



Communicate professionally with clients, providers, adjusters, lienholders, and internal tea
mbers.



Manage multiple cases while staying organized and responsive.



Required Qualifications



Applicants must have:



2–3 years of experience in personal injury prelitigation case management.



Prior experience working for a personal injury law firm.



Experience managing personal injury cases before litigation.



Experience communicating with clients, insurance adjusters, medical providers, billing offices, and lienholders.



Experience requesting and organizing medical records and bills.



Experience tracking medical treatment and case progress.



Experience handling or assisting with property damage claims.



Strong written and verbal English skills.



Strong attention to detail.



Ability to work independently and follow instructions.



Ability to organize digital files and manage multiple cases.



Reliable internet connection and computer.



Availability during U.S. business hours.



Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



Arizona or New Mexico personal injury claims.



Case management software such as CASEpeer, SmartAdvocate, Filevine, Clio, Litify, or similar.



Handling UM/UIM, MedPay, and bodily injury claims.



Working with liens, health insurance reimbursement, Medicare, Medicaid, AHCCCS, ERISA, or workers’ compensation liens.



Preparing cases for settlement demands or policy-limit opportunities.



Reviewing medical records and bills.



Spanish-speaking ability.



Experience working remotely for a U.S.-based law firm.



Who Should Not Apply



Please do not apply if:



You are new to legal work.



You have no personal injury experience.



You have never managed prelitigation personal injury cases.



You have never communicated with insurance adjusters or medical providers.



You are unfamiliar with medical records and bills.



You need extensive training on basic personal injury case management tasks.



You are unavailable during U.S. business hours.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and experienced in personal injury prelitigation work. We need someone who can step into a client-facing case management role and help move cases forward without constant supervision.



You should be comfortable communicating with clients, tracking treatment, organizing records and bills, following up with providers and adjusters, identifying missing information, and preparing files for settlement review.



This role requires someone who cares about clients, keeps cases moving, and understands that strong prelitigation case management directly affects case outcomes.



How to Apply



Please submit:



Your resume.



A short explanation of your personal injury prelitigation experience.



The types of personal injury cases you have handled.



The case management software you have used.



Your experience with medical records, bills, liens, insurance adjusters, and settlement preparation.



Your expected monthly salary.



Your availability to work U.S. business hours.



In your application, please include the phrase:



Experienced PI Client Advocate

title: HubSpot Administrator / RevOps Specialist - US Mountain Time
description:
Contract-to-Hire · 100% Remote (Philippines) · US Mountain Time Hours



About Us & the Role

We are a fast-growing roofing and exteriors company serving residential, commercial, and industrial customers across several US markets (Denver, Wyoming, Chicago, and Eastern North Carolina). We operate our own custo
tal fabrication shops and bring a high degree of specialization to our work. After several years of rapid growth, we are now strengthening and unifying our systems to support our next phase.

We are seeking a skilled HubSpot Administrator / RevOps Specialist to help manage and improve our CRM ecosystem. This is a specialized role, not a general data-entry position, and you will not be working on your own. You will join a dedicated RevOps team alongside our US-based administrators, with an in-house DevOps engineer handling custom code and API development, so you can focus on doing excellent work within HubSpot. Your work will be collaborative and reviewed, you will have access to senior expertise to learn from, and you will take on increasing ownership over time.

We are hiring on a contract basis to begin, with a clear path to full-time for the right person. The contract period gives both sides a chance to confirm it is a strong fit.







What You'll Do

Administer HubSpot across Marketing, Sales, and Operations Hubs — workflows, custom properties, deal pipelines, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, lists, segmentation, and user management.

Build and optimize workflows — including cleaning up and streamlining bloated or redundant automations so our systems stay fast and reliable.

Build reports and dashboards that give leadership accurate, trustworthy visibility into the funnel and operations across multiple locations.

Help consolidate and unify our HubSpot environment as we grow and acquire — working toward one clean, consistent experience across brands and locations.

Maintain rigorous data integrity — deduplication, data quality, and reporting accuracy that holds up to scrutiny.

Take over ongoing QuotaPath administration — comp-plan maintenance, troubleshooting, and day-to-day upkeep — to offload this recurring work from senior staff. (Already integrated; this is operational ownership, not a setup project.)

Manage our connected toolstack — PandaDoc, CompanyCam, SalesRabbit, QuotaPath, and our marketing-technology providers — keeping native integrations healthy and data flowing cleanly.

Partner with our in-house DevOps engineer on integrations and data movement. You won't build the custom middleware that transforms data between systems, but you should be able to speak knowledgeably about how that data flows and collaborate effectively on it.

Scope and execute build-outs and projects with growing independence, from requirements to ship.

Work within two-week sprints in ClickUp, managing your own tasks and deliverables.

Partner on AI initiatives as we implement AI across our systems to speed up delivery.

Document processes and create SOPs so the systems you build are durable and well-understood.

Expert Collaboration. Ability to communicate, respond, and ask questions through tools such as Zoom, Loom, 
, and Clickup.





What You Bring (Must-Haves)

3+ years hands-on HubSpot administration / RevOps experience, ideally spanning Marketing, Sales, AND Operations Hubs.

Proven ability to architect properties and pipelines and build, troubleshoot, and optimize sophisticated workflows.

Comfort managing HubSpot's native integrations and collaborating with technical teammates on data flows. (You won't be writing custom code or building APIs — we have a DevOps engineer for that — but you should understand how the pieces connect.)

Excellent written and spoken English — you can gather requirements, explain technical concepts clearly, and communicate proactively with a US team.

A process-driven, detail-obsessed approach to data and documentation.

A collaborative, coachable mindset — you take direction and feedback well and raise your hand when something's unclear.

Comfort working in an agile / sprint workflow and a task manager (ClickUp ideal).

Ability and willingness to work US Mountain Time business hours (see Schedule below).





Nice-to-Haves

HubSpot certifications (Marketing Software, Sales Software, Revenue Operations, Reporting, etc.). These are free — a motivated admin usually has several.

Experience consolidating or migrating multiple HubSpot portals (multi-brand, multi-location, or acquisition-driven).

Experience supporting roofing, home-services, or field-sales organizations (door-to-door and virtual sales models).

Hands-on experience with QuotaPath, PandaDoc, CompanyCam, or SalesRabbit.

Experience using AI tools to automate or accelerate operations.

Familiarity with custom-coded workflow actions (JavaScript/Python) — a bonus, not a requirement.





Schedule & Engagement

Engagement: Contract to start, with a clear path to full-time for the right fit.

Hours: Approximately 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Mountain Time, eventually building to 40 hours/week. We can flex the start/end by up to about an hour. Please note: this corresponds to roughly 10:00 PM – 7:00 AM Manila time — a night-shift role.



How to Apply

To show you've read this far, start your application with the word "PIPELINE" at the very top.



Then please include:



A short summary of the most complex HubSpot build-out or workflow you've personally owned — the problem, what you built, and the result.

An example of a time you cleaned up, optimized, or fixed a messy workflow or CRM — what was wrong and what you did.

Whether you've ever consolidated, migrated, or merged multiple HubSpot portals (multi-brand, multi-location, or acquisition) — and what that involved.

Whether you've administered QuotaPath or a similar commission/compensation tool, and to what depth.

Which HubSpot integrations and connected tools you've managed, and how you've collaborated with technical teammates when deeper integration work was needed.

Confirmation that you're able to work US Mountain Time hours.

Any HubSpot certifications you hold, plus links to a portfolio, case study, or short Loom walkthrough if available.



*** Application will be reviewed with an average 3 day response time. 



*** Selected candidate will be contracted and paid to complete a Hubspot project that involves extensive knowledge of Hubspot Objects, Workflows, Calculated Properties, and Reports. Candidate will be evaluated on problem solving, communication and asking questions.

title: Full-Time Short-Form Video Editor for Scaling Paid Ads (work directly with our Creative Strategist)
description:
We run paid video ads at real scale and we're hiring ONE full-time short-form editor to sit at the center of our creative team. You won't be a render monkey cranking out edits from a brief and never hearing back. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with our Creative Strategist — pitching hooks, iterating on winners, killing losers, and shaping what we actually put money behind.

This is for someone who already edits at a high level and wants one serious long-term home where their craft matters and grows.

What you'll own:



Editing high-retention short-form ads (hooks, pacing, captions, sound design — the stuff that d
 whether an ad scales or dies).

Turning rough briefs and raw footage into ads that hold attention and convert.

Sitting in idea sessions with our strategist and bringing your OWN angles, not just executing ours. (When you apply you'll need a codeword — it's Kanelbulle — keep it, you'll use it below.)

Fast iteration: taking a winning ad and spinning out variations that beat it.



Who we're looking for:



You don't just cut clips — you understand why a video keeps someone watching. You have taste. You can defend an editing decision but you're not precious about your ego when the data disagrees. You're fast without getting sloppy, and you want to be part of a team, in it every day, not juggling ten clients.

Who should NOT apply:



Anyone sending a generic reel to 50 job posts. This application is built to filter that out in five seconds — so let's not waste each other's time.

How to apply — this IS the first test:



Subject line, formatted EXACTLY like this:



KANELBULLE | [years editing short-form/paid ads] | [main editing software] | [hours/day overlap 00:00–00:00 CET]| [Can you work on weekends?]



Example: KANELBULLE | 5 | Capcut | 7|Yes

First line of your message: the single edit you're most proud of and the result it drove (views, hook rate, CTR, sales — whatever you have). One or two real sentences. Generic = deleted.

Send links to your 2–3 BEST short-form/ad edits. Not a full reel — curate. Your judgment about what to show me is part of the test.

Send me ONE short-form ad you did NOT make that you think is excellent, plus 1–2 sentences on exactly why it works (the hook, the pacing, the retention trick). This tells me how you think.

One honest answer: describe a time you disagreed with creative direction. What did you do?

The last line of your message must be your single most-used keyboard shortcut while editing — and what you use it for.



Do not attach a generic CV. If your subject line, your picks, and your thinking are sharp, you go to a short paid test edit — and that's where the role is won.

We read every application that follows these steps and ignore every one that doesn't. Show me you've got the eye.

**Lead Management & Follow-Up**

• Prioritize and pursue longer-term leads (2026–2027 bookings) as high-value opportunities

• Log all lead activity and communication history in Dubsado

• Identify and flag leads that are unresponsive or require escalation to the owner

**Payment Collection & Follow-Up**

• Send payment reminders via text and phone calls in addition to Dubsado’s automated
 reminders

• Communicate clearly with clients regarding late payment consequences, including potential event cancellation

• Send formal final notice
s to non-responsive clients regarding fund retention per the cancellation policy

• Maintain an organized payment tracker to flag overdue accounts and upcoming due dates

Event Details & Administrative Support

• Assist with organizing event timelines and communicating logistics to clients ahead of their event date

• Support general administrative tasks as needed to keep operations running smoothly

Dubsado CRM Management

• Support the setup and optimization of automated workflows for tours versus direct bookings

---

Digital Embroidery Experience

title: Graphic Design & Creative specialist
description:
Do you live at the intersection of design and technology? Are you someone who wakes up genuinely excited about what AI can do for creative work — and then actually goes and builds it? Swerv Digital is looking for a creative mind who can produce high-quality ad creatives at volume, help shape our design system, and be a core part of a small team that moves fast and never stops evolving.



About Swerv Digital:



Swerv Digital is a performance marketing agency based in Aarhus, Denmark. We are a small, tight-knit team — Viktor, Frederik, and RJ — and we are looking for someone who will not just fill a role, but genuinely become part of the team for the long haul.



Our biggest strength is flexibility. We move fast, constantly test new AI models, and adapt the way we work as better tools emerge. We do not hold on to old processes for the sake of comfort. If something better comes along, we adopt it. Our most-used AI tools right now are Manus, Claude, and Lovable — and that list will keep growing.



We work with ambitious e-commerce and service businesses, helping them scale through sharp strategy and high-quality execution. Design and creative output is a critical part of that — and that is where you come in.



The Role:



This is a creative role with a strong AI-forward focus. You will be responsible for producing ad creatives across multiple clients, building and maintaining our graphic design system, creating website mockups, and — most importantly — helping us build a creative AI hub that allows us to produce high volumes of quality content efficiently and consistently.



This is also a role where you will learn a lot. The way we work changes constantly because AI keeps getting better, and you will be at the centre of that evolution. If you enjoy figuring things out, building new workflows, and pushing the boundaries of what is possible with the tools available, you will thrive here.



Key Responsibilities:



Ad Creative Production: Design and deliver high-converting ad creatives for multiple e-commerce clients simultaneously. You will work across formats — static, video-first concepts, carousels, and UGC-style content — maintaining quality and brand consistency at speed.



Creative AI Hub Development: Take the lead on building a scalable creative AI system that enables the team to produce high volumes of creatives efficiently. This includes setting up AI-assisted workflows, prompt libraries, template systems, and production pipelines using tools like Claude, Manus, Lovable, and others as they emerge.



Graphic Design System: Help build and maintain Swerv Digital's internal design system — including templates, brand guidelines for clients, and reusable asset libraries that make creative production faster and more consistent across the board.



Website Mockups & Visual Concepts: Create clear, compelling website mockups and visual concepts for clients, communicating design direction before development begins.



Tool Exploration & Adoption: Actively test new AI design tools and models as they emerge. You bring a genuine curiosity and a practical ability to evaluate what is worth adopting and what is noise.



Requirements:



Strong Graphic Design Skills: You have a solid foundation in graphic design — composition, typography, colour, and visual hierarchy. You can produce polished, professional work independently without needing heavy direction.



AI-First Creative Mindset: You are not just aware of AI tools — you use them daily, build with them, and think creatively about how to leverage them to produce better work faster. Experience with Claude, Canva AI, Midjourney, or similar tools is a strong advantage.



Design Tool Proficiency: You are comfortable working in tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro), and Canva. You do not need to be a master of all of them, but you need to be functional across the stack.



Ad Creative Experience: You understand what makes an ad perform. You have experience designing creatives for paid social — particularly Meta — and you know the difference between beautiful design and design that converts.



Strong English: You must be highly proficient in written and spoken English. Our team communicates in English, our clients operate across markets, and the quality of your written communication matters.



Proactive & Creative Thinker: You do not wait to be told what to do. You spot gaps, propose ideas, and bring energy to the work. In a team of three, initiative is not optional — it is essential.



Team Fit: We are a small, international team and we are looking for someone who wants to grow with us over years, not months. RJ, one of our core tea
mbers, is Filipino, and we value a team culture that is open, direct, and genuinely collaborative. Cultural fit matters as much as skill.



Nice to Have:



Video Editing: If you have experience editing short-form video content — whether for paid ads, social media, or client campaigns — that is a significant bonus. We produce video content for clients and having someone who can cut, pace, and polish footage (in Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar) means you can contribute across the full creative stack. It is not a requirement, but it will make you stand out.



Why Join Swerv Digital?



At Swerv Digital, you will not be one of twenty designers in a department. You will be the creative voice of a fast-moving agency, with direct influence over how we work and what we produce. You will work closely with Viktor, Frederik, and RJ on real client accounts, with real budgets, and see the direct impact of your work.



You will be at the forefront of AI-driven creative production — not reading about it in newsletters, but actually building it. We invest in our team's development and create space for continuous learning, because the better you get, the better we all get.



If you are someone who is energized by change, loves building things, and wants to be part of a team that genuinely cares about doing great work — this is the place for you.





How to Apply



Send your portfolio, a short introduction about yourself, and any examples of graphic design, AI-assisted creative work and video editing you have done. Send it to: 



We are not looking for the most polished CV. We are looking for the right person.

Tip: Make something nice out of your application, so you stand out.

title: Senior VAT & Bookkeeping Specialist (EU & UK Compliance)
description:
Job Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced and detail-oriented Senior VAT & Bookkeeping Specialist to manage and oversee our international tax compliance and financial record-keeping. The ideal candidate will possess an extensive background in preparing, reconciling, and filing complex EU VAT documents, including Input/Output VAT and Intra-community transactions. Strong knowledge of UK VAT regulations is highly advantageous.



As a core requirement, you must have advanced Excel capabilities to manipulate large datasets and a rock-solid foundation in full-cycle bookkeeping.



Key Responsibilities

International VAT Compliance & Filings

EU VAT Management: Prepare, review, and finalize all documentation required for EU VAT filings, ensuring absolute accuracy for Input and Output VAT.



Intra-Community Reporting: Oversee and execute Intra-community declarations, EC Sales Lists (ESL), and Intrastat reporting where applicable.



UK VAT Compliance (Plus): Handle UK VAT returns in accordance with HMRC guidelines and Making Tax Digital (MTD) requirements.



Cross-Border Transactions: Analyze and correctly apply VAT rules to cross-border B2B and B2C transactions, ensuring proper tax determination.



Audit Readiness: Act as the primary point of contact for VAT audits, maintaining clean documentation and clear audit trails.



Bookkeeping & Data Reconciliation

Full-Cycle Bookkeeping: Perform daily bookkeeping tasks, ensuring all financial transactions are accurately recorded in the accounting software.



Accounts Reconciliation: Reconcile VAT accounts against the general ledger, bank statements, and sales platforms to identify and resolve discrepancies promptly.



Month-End Closing: Support the month-end and year-end closing processes by preparing accurate journal entries and tax accruals.



Data Management & Excel Modeling

Advanced Data Manipulation: Utilize advanced Microsoft Excel functions to clean, consolidate, and analyze high-volume transactional data from multiple sources.



Reporting: Build and maintain automated Excel templates for VAT forecasting, variance analysis, and internal reporting.



Requirements & Qualifications

Experience: 5+ years of dedicated experience in international VAT compliance (specifically EU VAT) and full-cycle bookkeeping.



Technical Expertise: Comprehensive understanding of EU VAT directives, triangulation, and Intra-community supply/acquisition rules. Experience with UK HMRC/VAT filings is a strong plus.



Excel Mastery (Non-Negotiable): Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel is a must. You must be comfortable using Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, data nesting, and handling large CSV/data exports.



Software Skills: Hands-on experience with major accounting software (e.g., Xero, QuickBooks, SAP, Netsuite) and specialized VAT automation tools is preferred.



Attention to Detail: Exceptional analytical skills with a sharp eye for spotting discrepancies in financial data.



Communication: Fluent in English (written and spoken), with the ability to explain complex tax concepts clearly to internal stakeholders.

Foundation problems

Problem tenants

18 Eagles

As-is houses

Common wholesaler tactics homeowners should avoid

Behind-the-scenes content

Homeowner education

Seller mistakes to avoid

Why some sellers choose convenience over top dollar

Social Media Management:



You will manage:




Instagram

TikTok

YouTube Shorts

X

Responsibilities include:



Posting content

Repurposing content

Testing different content styles

Improving engagement

Growing local followers

Responding to comments

Participating in conversations

Increasing awareness of Ninebird Properties throughout DFW

We are NOT looking for:



Purchased followers

Follow/unfollow strategies

Engagement pods

Generic motivational content

Dancing videos

Someone who constantly needs approval before taking action

Someone who simply schedules posts and waits for instructions

Success Looks Like

title: YouTube Video Editor & Channel Manager (Growth Path to Content Strategist)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We're hiring a skilled, reliable YouTube editor to own the full production and publishing process for the channel — and grow into a content strategist who helps shape what we make.



This is a long-term role with a steady, full-time workload. You'll start as our editor and channel manager. As you prove yourself, there's a clear, paid path to becoming our strategist.



WHAT YOU'LL DO — Editor & Channel Manager ($1,500/month USD)



Editing:



- Edit long-form videos (10-15 min): talking-head + screen-share, educational style (we'll share examples of the look we want)

- Edit short-form videos (Shorts) and ad creatives — many of these are cut down from the long-form footage

- Apply retention-focused editing: tight pacing, captions/subtitles, b-roll, zooms, pattern interrupts, and clean audio





Thumbnails:



Design click-worthy thumbnails that match our established style (examples provided)



Channel management:



- Write SEO-optimized titles, descriptions, and tags

- Add end screens and cards

- Schedule and publish videos



MONTHLY VOLUME



At peak, expect up to:



- 8 long-form videos (10-15 min)

- 30 short-form videos

- 20-30 ad creatives



Many of the Shorts and ads are repurposed from the long-form videos, so this is more manageable than the numbers suggest — but you should be fast, organized, and comfortable running a real content pipeline.



THE GROWTH PATH — Content Strategist (up to $2,000/month USD)



Once you've mastered the editing and channel role and shown you understand what makes our content work, you can grow into a strategist. In that role, you'll:



- Pitch video ideas and angles

- Research topics and write scripts for us to shoot



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Proven YouTube editing experience (please show both long-form and short-form work)

- Strong thumbnail design skills with an eye for what earns clicks

- Familiarity with YouTube publishing — SEO titles/descriptions, end screens, cards, scheduling

- Excellent written and spoken English (you'll join occasional meetings and eventually write scripts)

- Self-managed, deadline-driven, and communicative — someone who doesn't need to be micromanaged

- Bonus: experience with business, educational, or talking-head content; scriptwriting or content ideation



Use whatever editing and design tools you prefer. We care about the output, not the software.



HOURS & SETUP



This is a remote, mostly asynchronous role. We don't track your hours — we care that the work gets done well and on time. The only fixed requirement is being available for the occasional meeting during US Eastern (EST) morning hours.



HOW TO APPLY



We hire in three stages. Please read carefully — applications that don't follow these instructions will not be considered.



Stage 1 — Application

Reply to this job with all of the following:



- Start your message with the word UPVOTE, so we know you read this post.

- A link to your portfolio (YouTube editing work — ideally both long-form and short-form).

- A short Loom video (2-3 minutes): open our channel 
 pick one video, and tell us 2-3 specific things you'd change about the edit and/or thumbnail to make it better. We want to see how you think.



Stage 2 — Paid Test Edit (invited candidates only)

We'll pay you $20 to complete a short test: find a Shorts-worthy 
nt in one of our YouTube videos, edit it into a polished 30-60 second Short, and submit it. We pay for this because we respect your time.



Stage 3 — Interview

A short video interview to make sure we're the right fit for each other.



We're looking for someone to grow with us for the long haul. If that's you, we'd love to see your work.

title: Editor for a Moto-Vlog Style YouTube Channel
description:
I THINK WE MISSED A TURN: Editor for a Moto-Vlog Style YouTube Channel - TCAT Remapping Expedition 2026



Editor for a Moto-Vlog Style YouTube Channel

OVERVIEW

- Craig Luke is a Canadian Moto-Vlogger based in Nelson, British Columbia. He is currently riding solo, coast to coast off-road, to remap the Trans Canada Adventure Trail. 15,000 km from Grant Bay on Vancouver Island to St. John's, Newfoundland. Roughly six months on the dirt road. You are the editor who turns each journey's raw footage into a finished, upload-ready video.

- This is off-road adventure motorcycling content made by riders for riders. Authentic and practical. Real Canadian backcountry travel, not influencer polish. He shoots on a lightweight Kove 450 Rally and lives on a strict $50/day budget. Footage comes off the trail and uploads via Starlink Mini from remote campsites. Every video should feel like the viewer is out there with him.

- Style benchmark is Itchy Boots 
 story-driven pacing built around solo travel, geographic progression, map tracking and the raw beauty of the trail. Not hyper-edited visual noise.

- Publish cadence is once every three days to start. Turnaround is within 48 hours from the 
nt a journey's assets are ready.



THE ROLE

- We outline each episode in a shared Google Sheet. An episode may cover one day or several days. You build one finished episode per outline.

- We engage you video by video to start.

- If we like your work and we are working well together, we build a longer-term relationship from there.

- We want a go-to editor for the entire 15,000km project across Canada and beyond.

- The Google Sheet which is our production hub.



REVIEW THE CHANNEL FIRST

- Watch the current channel for context and style: 

- We want you to match the rider-to-rider feel and then raise the bar.

- Come with ideas. Better pacing, cleaner sound design, sharper color, smarter cutaways, stronger hooks and openings, chapter markers, retention editing.

- Tell us what you would do differently and why.



REFERENCE VIDEOS (watch before you start)

- Study these before your first edit. They show the target. Match the pacing, energy and storytelling. Do not copy shot for shot.

- Style we are aiming for: youtu.be/t8R4xB9k6xI

- Reference: youtu.be/6cmY8qEdvIM

- Channel benchmark: Itchy Boots, 



SOURCE FOOTAGE

- Craig shoots each day on three cameras.

- Insta360 X4 Air. 360 capture for reframing and impossible angles. 8K.

- Insta360 GO Ultra. Mounted POV and cube shots.

- Phone. Handheld and talking-to-camera footage.



WHERE EVERYTHING LIVES

- Google Sheet (production hub). Every episode outlines lives here. The narrative spine, titles, descriptions, tags, notes, locations and track links. An outline may span multiple days. This is your starting point for every episode.

- Google Drive day folders. Raw footage from the three cameras, photos of people and scenery, Craig's voiceover and in most cases the route map video file.

- 
. The route map is usually dropped into the Drive folder as a finished video. In some cases over the next two weeks you may need to grab the route video for the day from 
 yourself. Craig is moving toward providing it automatically in the folder.

- Insta360 Studio app. Where you reframe and export the 360 footage before Premiere, or you use the Insta360 plugin inside Premiere instead.



THE 360 WORKFLOW

- You handle the 360 footage one of two ways.

- Reframe and export the 360 footage in the Insta360 Studio app first, then bring it into Adobe Premiere Pro.

- Or use the Adobe Premiere Pro Insta360 plugin to import and reframe 
sv files directly inside Premiere.

- Pick the path your machine handles cleanly. Everything finishes in Premiere.



WHAT YOU BUILD

- One finished episode per outline.

- The route map worked into the video. Most days the map video is already in the Drive folder. Occasionally you pull it from 
.

- Craig's voiceover laid in as the spine of the story.

- The pre-made intro and outro applied to every video.

- People and scenery photos worked in as cutaways and b-roll where they fit the story.



EDIT APPROACH

- Follow the outline in the Google Sheet as the spine. It tells you where Craig was, where he was going and what happened.

- Cut for story first, polish second. The ride is the star. Find the arc. Geographic progress, the struggle, the breakdown, the triumph, the camp routine.

- Keep it honest. No fake drama. Sound like a rider, not a brand.

- Reframe the X4 360 footage to land the action. Use the small POV cam for mounted shots. Use the phone for Craig to camera.

- Pacing and sound design. Balance voiceover and music against crisp engine audio, wind and ambient nature sound. Build tension on technical trail. Go cinematic and calm at camp. The voice stays clear and on top.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND HARDWARE

- Expert editor in Adobe Premiere Pro. This is the only editor we use. We want every project built in Premiere so we can bring editing in-house later.

- Insta360 workflow. Reframe and stabilize 360 footage cleanly. Run the Insta360 Reframe plugin in Premiere or reframe and export in the Insta360 Studio app first.

- Handle heavy 4K and 8K files smoothly.

- Audio layering and sound design. Balance voiceover, camera audio, engine sound and music so the voice stays crystal clear.

- Story editing. Find the narrative arc in hours of raw trail footage without over-editing. The Itchy Boots flow.

- Strong English comprehension. You follow written outlines and check on-screen metadata against what actually happened on camera.

- Reliable communication and on-time delivery inside the 48 hour window.

- Fast internet and a high-spec machine. You will pull heavy 8K and 4K files from Google Drive and the Insta360 cloud.



NICE TO HAVE (strong bonus, not required)

- Map and motion graphics. Generate route paths from GPX using Google Earth Studio, After Effects or a dedicated mapping plugin. In most cases the route map is provided for you. Relive supplies the motion graphics if they come on as a sponsor. Otherwise we build it through Google Maps or another option. This is a real plus if you can do it.

- After Effects for titles, lower thirds and clean motion graphics.

- Color grading in Lumetri.

- Thumbnail design.

- Experience editing travel, moto, outdoor or adventure content.



WHAT WE LOOK FOR IN YOU

- Detail focused. You catch the small things.

- Self-managed. We do not track your hours. You hold the milestones and the quality.

- A storyteller, not just a button pusher.

- In it for the long haul. We want one editor for the whole expedition.



DELIVERY AND APPROVAL



- Drop two files back into the journey's Google Drive folder. The Adobe Premiere master project file (once approved and finalized) and the finished video file.

- Do not upload anything to YouTube. We handle that ourselves for now. We bring you into that once we have worked together for a while.

- Use the title, description and tags from the Google Sheet. If Craig covered something on camera that was not in the outline, update the metadata to match what actually happened.

- Tell us the episode is ready for review. All of this inside the 48 hour turnaround window.



COMPENSATION AND WORK TERMS



- We are a Canadian company. All pay is in Canadian dollars (CAD).

- Structure. Paid per completed video. One finished longform episode, 15 to 20 minutes.

- Trial rate. $65 CAD per video for your first 3 videos. This is a paid trial so we both confirm the fit.

- Standard rate. $100 CAD per video from video 4 onward, once the trial passes review and we are working well together.

- Growth bonus. When the channel hits 20,000 subscribers you earn a bonus on every video on top of your per-video rate.

- Performance bonus. Once the channel revenue grows we add a bonus tied to views on the videos you personally edit. This is added to your base, never in place of it.

- Monthly retainer. When the channel is profitable we are willing to move you to a monthly retainer plus bonuses.

- Payment schedule. Paid after each video is completed. We move to a monthly salary when the channel hits 50,000 subscribers. Paid in CAD.

- Flexibility. We do not track your hours. You manage your own schedule as long as the milestones and quality hold for each delivery.

- Long-term potential. We want one go-to editor for the full 15,000km project across Canada and beyond.



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully)

- We only hire people who pay attention to detail. Automated or copy-pasted applications get ignored. In your application include the items below.

- The secret phrase. Start your message with this exact line: "I found the turn! - ITWMAT Video Editor".

- Your portfolio. Links to YouTube or adventure content you personally edited. Include examples with maps or heavy voiceover.

- Production ideas. After watching the channel, name two or three specific things you would do to raise the production quality.

- Your project rate. Confirm our per-video structure works, or give your target rate in CAD per 15 to 20 minute finished video.

- Your gear and connection. A short description of your computer specs and a screenshot of your internet download and upload speed.



NEXT STEP

- Watch both reference videos and the current channel, then reply with your questions on the open specs and your production ideas so we can lock everything before the first folder lands.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
A company in the marketing industry is looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Project Coordinator to join the team on a full-time, remote basis. This role is central to keeping programs, partnerships, and events running smoothly. You will serve as the main coordination point across internal teams and external stakeholders, making sure projects stay on schedule and that all deliverables meet high standards for quality and professionalism.



This is a remote position. Work schedule is Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM PST.





ABOUT THE ROLE



As Project Coordinator, you will touch nearly every area of operations, from managing communications and membership records to coordinating multi-project timelines and supporting event logistics. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, takes initiative, communicates clearly, and can juggle competing priorities without dropping the ball.





RESPONSIBILITIES



- Provide general administrative support, including calendar management, file organization, data entry, and other day-to-day operational tasks as needed.

- Manage the organization's
 inbox by monitoring, responding to, and routing messages to keep communication timely and organized.

- Draft and send
 communications to members, including announcements, updates, and event-related outreach.

- Maintain and update membership records, contact lists, and engagement data to support member communications and reporting.

- Coordinate on bookkeeping items, including tracking payments and supporting financial recordkeeping at a coordinator level.

- Work closely with the marketing and social media teams on newsletters, website updates, and related content to keep communications consistent and on brand.

- Monitor event registrations, assist with attendee communications, and maintain registration and attendance records.

- Provide remote support for events, including coordination, logistics, and follow-up tasks.

- Assist with social media and website efforts by helping shape the direction of posts, updating event postings and web content, and QAing for accuracy, consistency, and brand alignment before publishing.

- Coordinate timelines, deliverables, and logistics across multiple concurrent projects, including media partnerships, brand collaborations, and community events.

- Proactively identify bottlenecks, missing information, and upcoming deadlines, helping keep projects moving forward and stakeholders informed.

- Maintain project documentation, trackers, and status reports to keep all stakeholders aligned.

- Support the preparation and quality review of external-facing materials, including presentation decks, partnership proposals, and media collateral, ensuring accuracy and consistency before external handoff.

- Serve as a liaison between the organization and partner organizations, vendors, and consultants.

- Schedule and facilitate meetings, capture action items, and follow up to ensure completion.

- Occasionally assist with tasks that overlap across organizational programs, such as preparing or reviewing documents, proposals, or narratives.





QUALIFICATIONS



- 2 or more years of project coordination, administrative, or operations experience, preferably in a partnerships, media, or nonprofit setting.

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with high attention to detail in copy accuracy and formatting.

- Familiarity with social media platforms and Canva, including the ability to open and navigate files, leave and respond to comments, and make basic updates.

- Proficiency with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive) and common project management and productivity tools.

- Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across internal teams and external partners.

- Comfortable in a remote work environment with a proactive, self-starter mindset.





HOW TO APPLY



Send your



• "Your Updated Resume"

• "Professional Introduction Video." You can use Loom for the video, just avoid the screen share setting as we want to see your full profile.

title: Real Estate Transaction Coordinator (VA)
description:
Every deal our team closes has one thing in common — someone behind the scenes made sure every piece was in the right place at the right time. That person is what we're looking for.

You won't be in the spotlight. But without you, nothing moves. If you find genuine satisfaction in being the reason things run smoothly — and you don't need recognition to stay motivated — read on.

What keeping things running looks like:



Transaction oversight — managing deal timelines, coordinating deadlines, and maintaining organized files from the first day a deal opens to the 
nt it closes

title: HR Support Specialist
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

M&M Solutions LLC is a cleaning company based in Marin County, California with a team of 30+ workers — a mix of W-2 employees and 1099 independent contractors. We have been operating since late 2024 and growing quickly, but without a dedicated HR function. We are now building the HR infrastructure properly: hiring systems, onboarding, compliance, and documentation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We need an HR Support Specialist who can take ownership of our people operations. You will manage our hiring pipeline, build onboarding processes for new cleaning staff, maintain employee documentation, and help ensure we are operating in compliance with California labor law. California has its own specific employment rules that differ from the rest of the US — you must understand them or be ready to learn them immediately. This is a role for someone organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable building structure in a company that is still formalizing its processes.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Hiring — Post job openings, screen applicants, coordinate interviews, manage the candidate pipeline end-to-end

• Onboarding — Build and manage the onboarding process for new cleaning staff (documentation, orientation, scheduling)

• HR Documentation — Maintain employee records, employment contracts, and compliance documentation

• Offboarding — Manage the offboarding process when staff separate

• HR Admin — Draft HR documents (offer letters, warning notices, onboarding checklists), answer employee questions

• Compliance — Support California-specific HR compliance requirements



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Proven HR admin or recruiting experience — ideally for a US-based company

• Working knowledge of California labor law is required — daily overtime rules, break requirements, employee vs. contractor classification, and CA employment compliance

• Familiarity with QuickBooks or similar payroll tools

• Experience with applicant tracking or structured hiring pipelines

• Strong organizational skills — HR records must be accurate and complete

• Ability to draft professional HR documents in English

• Comfortable building processes from scratch — we do not have fully built systems yet

• High discretion — you will be handling sensitive employee information



BONUS POINTS

• Background check coordination experience

• Experience supporting field-based or service industry workers

• Bilingual English/Spanish is a strong bonus — our cleaning team is predominantly Spanish-speaking



SCHEDULE & RATE

Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM US Pacific Time

This is a high-trust, high-leverage role. You won't just complete tasks — you'll keep the whole operation moving: coordinating the team, managing suppliers, driving every project to completion, and making sure nothing slips through the cracks. If you're proactive, obsessively organized, and you love being the person everyone relies on, this is for you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Be the right hand to the two founders — own their priorities, to-dos, follow-ups, calendar and inbox; keep them focused on strategy by taking everything else off their plate.

• Coordinate the team & projects — keep our builder, media buyer, creatives and support staff on track; run our project management tool (ClickUp / Notion); chase deadlines and unblock work.

• Support new brand launches — replicate our processes for every new brand we launch, and keep everything organized and documented (SOPs).

• Track progress & flag blockers — give us clear visibility on what's done, what's stuck, and what needs attention.



YOU'RE A GREAT FIT IF YOU

• Have 2–3+ years as an Executive Assistant, Operations Coordinator or Project Manager — ideally in e-commerce / DTC.

• Communicate in excellent written and spoken English.

• Are extremely organized, proactive and reliable — you take ownership and follow through without being chased.

• Are fluent with tools: project management (ClickUp, Notion, Asana), Google Workspace, spreadsheets, and basic Shopify / e-commerce admin.

• Have experience communicating with suppliers (overseas suppliers a big plus).

NICE TO HAVE

• Shopify / e-commerce operations experience.

• Experience coordinating remote teams.

• Light finance / bookkeeping or reporting experience.



THE SETUP

Full-time, long-term, work-from-home. You'll grow with us as we scale from one brand to a full portfolio. Real responsibility, real growth, and a central seat in the business.



HOW TO APPLY (please read carefully)

1) Start your message with the word "ANCHOR" so I know you actually read this.

2) In a few sentences, describe your experience as an EA / Operations Coordinator — which companies, how big the team you coordinated, and what you were responsible for.

5) Your availability (hours, timezone / overlap) and your monthly rate.

title: Financial Controller
description:
Company Overview

FetchMe LLC is an Atlanta-based restaurant technology platform—the “Shopify for Restaurants”—powering ~200 merchants across 30 metros with an integrated delivery and catering operations layer. Currently at $3M ARR and actively raising a Series A, we are moving fast to build the best restaurant operating system while keeping costs low for our merchants. Our mission focuses on helping independent restaurants reclaim revenue from high-fee aggregators by giving them the tools to run their own high-margin delivery and catering channels.

Our finance operations span multi-market driver pay, complex merchant payment reconciliation, and the high-level reporting discipline required to be investor-ready. We run lean, move fast, and value operational efficiency.



Position Summary:

Type: Full-time, 40 hours/week

Location: Remote (Philippines)

Hours: U.S. Business Hours (significant CST overlap required; exact schedule has flexibility, but core availability during peak U.S. morning/afternoon hours is necessary for team alignment).

Reports to: Co-Founder / Chief Growth Officer (dotted line to CEO, Atlanta)

Compensation: $13–$17/hr, commensurate with experience (FTE ~$27K–$35K/year)



The Financial Controller is a hands-on role dedicated to owning the day-to-day accounting close and bringing extreme rigor to a high-transaction-volume, multi-market operation. This is an ownership seat for the books, reconciliations, and the strict controls required to keep them flawless. You will work directly with the founding team and have a highly visible impact on our Series A diligence readiness.



Core Responsibilities

1. Financial Reporting & Month-End Close

Full Close Ownership: Run the entire month-end close cycle, including journal entries, accruals, and GL reconciliation.

Reporting Packages: Deliver a clean, accurate, and on-time monthly financial package.

Diligence Support: Prepare financial schedules and reconciliations that feed directly into board reporting and investor diligence.

2. High-Volume Reconciliation & Spend Management

Stripe / Payment Processing: Reconcile payments, refunds, and disputes across a growing merchant base (currently ~50 active merchants). Investigate and resolve all variances to zero.

Driver Payroll: Tie out our multi-market driver pay infrastructure (hourly guarantees and catering workbooks) before payroll runs through Everee. Enforce a strict zero-variance tie-out prior to platform upload.

Merchant Payouts: Reconcile merchant-level revenue, platform fees, and final payouts across all active markets; flag and resolve discrepancies immediately.

Corporate Spend Ownership: Manage and optimize our Ramp spend management platform—overseeing corporate card workflows, expense auto-coding, receipt compliance, and bill pay mapping.

3. Treasury, AP/AR, & Internal Controls

Cash Management: Maintain routine cash position reporting and assist the founders in tracking burn-rate metrics.

AP/AR: Manage vendor invoicing, corporate expenses, and receivables tracking.

Controls & Documentation: Build, maintain, and improve internal controls and process documentation to ensure the close process is repeatable and audit-ready.

Process Automation: Document manual workflows and actively look for opportunities to make them AI-enabled or automated, ensuring that money-movement steps always require human approval.



Candidate Qualifications

Must-Have Requirements

Experience: 3+ years in accounting/controller roles, ideally supporting a U.S.-based company.

GL Ownership: Demonstrated experience running an entire month-end close cycle independently, not just supporting it.

Software Proficiencies: Advanced, hands-on proficiency with QuickBooks Online (QBO), Ramp (or a closely comparable spend management / AP platform), and Advanced Excel (comfortable managing complex, multi-tab workbooks using advanced formulas, flags, and tie-out logic).

Transaction Volume: Proven experience managing high-volume data reconciliation (e.g., payment processors, payroll platforms, or gig-economy settlement systems).

AI Fluency: Actively leverages tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or similar to accelerate analysis, formula building, and reporting—while maintaining strong judgment around AI limitations and the need for human oversight on financial data.

Communication: C1/C2 level English with exceptional written and verbal skills for seamless collaboration with a U.S. founding team.

Infrastructure: A stable remote workspace with reliable internet and consistent availability for required U.S. CST overlap.

Nice-to-Have Attributes

Tech Stack Experience: Direct experience with Stripe, Everee (or similar payroll disbursement platforms), and Notion (where our core operational infrastructure lives).

ERP & Scaling: Exposure to NetSuite or similar ERPs, helpful for future migration as the company scales.

Automation Skills: Experience designing AI-assisted or automated workflows, prompt-driven reporting, or light scripting to eliminate manual close tasks.

Industry Background: Prior experience in high-growth SaaS, marketplaces, gig-economy platforms, logistics, or restaurant technology.



Benefits & Perks

Performance Bonus: Eligibility for performance-based bonuses tied to milestones like successful close cycles, audit readiness, and process efficiency.

Paid Time Off: Comprehensive PTO package aligned with observed US and PH holidays to ensure a balanced schedule.

Professional Development: Dedicated annual budget for accounting certifications, advanced software training, or technical workshops.

Schedule Flexibility: Enjoy some autonomy over your daily calendar, provided significant core CST collaboration hours are maintained.



What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

Day 30: Fully up to speed on the internal Stripe, Everee, Ramp, and driver-pay workbooks. Successfully shadowing and taking over weekly reconciliations.

Day 60: Running the month-end close with minimal oversight and executing flawless, zero-variance driver pay tie-outs on every cycle.

Day 90: Fully owning the close process independently, delivering the financial package strictly on the calendar, and having proposed at least two concrete process improvements to existing controls.



How to Apply

Please submit your résumé along with a cover letter detailing your most relevant, high-volume data reconciliation experience.

Note: Strong candidates will be invited to complete a short, paid reconciliation exercise to demonstrate proficiency.

description:
Role: CRO Specialist (Part-time / Per-project, Hourly, Remote)

Company: A growing health-tech e-commerce brand on Shopify

Rate: $12/hour



About the Role



We are a growing health-tech e-commerce brand on Shopify looking for a Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Specialist on a part-time / per-project basis. We are not looking for a "jack of all trades" or a general virtual assistant. We need a specialist whose primary focus, skill, and passion is CRO.



In this role, strategy is collaborative, but execution is independent. You will be responsible for translating briefs, offers, and copy into high-converting visual forms on our store. If you love digging into heatmaps, designing beautiful mockups, and building pages that drive revenue, this is the role for you.



We are a mobile-first brand. Mobile design is the priority. The majority of our traffic is on mobile, so every page must be designed and tested for mobile first.



What You Will Do





Visual Design and Mockups: Create high-quality visual mockups before building pages. You must be able to design. If you cannot create a mockup, this role is not a fit.

Page Building: Build and execute pages swiftly, preferably using GemPages (though we are open to other tools or AI methods as long as the final result is flawless and fast).

Mobile-First Execution: Design and QA every page for mobile first. Mobile design is the priority, with desktop following after.

Data Analysis and Optimization: Dive deep into CRO metrics, heatmaps, and click tracking to identify weak points in the customer journey and execute A/B tests.

Quality Assurance: Meticulously review your own work. You will be responsible for checking details like sale prices, mobile responsiveness, and brand consistency before anything goes live.

App Ecosystem Navigation: Use your knowledge of the Shopify app ecosystem to implement the best solutions for conversion tracking and page enhancements.





What We Are Looking For





A True Specialist: CRO must be your core skill. You do not need to be an expert in Google Analytics, Figma, or Canva, but you must be an expert in conversion.

Brand Experience: Proven experience working with branded Shopify stores. You must understand brand guidelines and consistency (no dropshipping-only experience).

The "Imagewriting" Mindset: You understand that images and text must work together as a single cohesive unit. We can teach you our specific framework, but you must naturally think this way.

Creative and Proactive: You have a creative mindset similar to an
 marketer, but applied to landing and product pages. You take initiative, suggest improvements, and execute without needing your hand held.

Speed and Precision: Fast execution is critical to our workflow, but it cannot come at the expense of attention to detail.





Schedule and Compensation





Part-time / per-project, paid hourly at $12/hour (hours must be tracked).

Flexible schedule. Hours can vary based on project load.

Sundays are completely off.

Flexible nature required: occasionally sales land on weekends and require brief availability.

We reward hard work generously. We offer bonuses, treats, and future growth opportunities for top performers.

Note: We maintain high standards. If performance does not meet expectations, the role will not continue.





To Apply



Please submit your application to "arvie.hiringmanager at gmail dot com" along with examples of landing pages you have designed and built, specifically highlighting your mockup process and the resulting conversion improvements.

Google Ads Ready

title: Social Media/ Short-Form Content Creator & Editor (Gaming + Car Culture)
description:
Short-Form Content Strategist & Editor (Gaming + Car Culture)

Part-Time (20 hrs/week) 

Remote 

Salary: USD $400/month + Results-Based Bonuses (clear raise path below) + sales commission (read description till end)

ABOUT ROBOPIXEL

RoboPixel (robopixel.eu) is a new brand in Germany (just launched) makes custom phone cases for people who live in two worlds:

SYSTEM — Gaming, cyberpunk, techwear, EDC, PC culture, futuristic aesthetics.

STREETS — Cars, JDM, tuners, drifting, street racing, automotive culture.

We're not building another generic phone accessory brand. We're building a culture-first brand for people who identify with these worlds. You create within the System and Streets worlds — that's the fence, and inside it you have huge creative freedom.

If terms like Cyberpunk 2077, Need for Speed, Initial D, JDM, PC setups, mechanical keyboards, techwear, racing games, drifting, and internet culture excite you rather than confuse you — keep reading.

Language & audience: Content is in English, aimed at the global gaming and car-culture community (our buyers skew European). You focus on culture and craft; I handle the local-market layer-if required.

THIS IS NOT JUST A VIDEO EDITING JOB

I'm a solo founder looking for someone to help build a brand from the ground up. I need someone who contributes ideas, researches trends, understands culture, and helps grow the brand — not someone who waits for instructions every day.

You'll post to RoboPixel-owned accounts (not your own), and you'll have a real say in where they go.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Content Research

• Research TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts, Reddit, and gaming + automotive communities

• Identify trends, formats, hooks, sounds, and styles that are performing

• Understand what makes gamers and car enthusiasts stop scrolling

Content Creation & Editing

• Create engaging short-form video from product images, our AI brand characters, AI tools, and licensed footage/trending formats

• Edit vertical videos with strong hooks, pacing, storytelling, captions, and retention techniques

• Entertain first, sell second — develop multiple concepts every week

Growth Strategy

• Recommend content ideas proactively and plan posting schedules

• Suggest experiments and tests, then analyze what works and what doesn't

• Bring ideas to the table instead of waiting for instructions

Community Building

• Engage with comments and DMs in our voice

• Turn viewers into followers and followers into fans



CADENCE, TOOLS & WHAT I PROVIDE

• Cadence: ~3–5 posts/week per platform (TikTok + IG to start). Community replies ~30 min/day.

• Hours: Async PH hours are fine. One short weekly sync call with me.

• I provide: a brand voice guide; an organized asset drive (designs, phone-case blank images); and a $70/month budget for Higgsfield (Plus plan / 1,200 credits) or your preferred AI content-creation platform.

• Asset rule: Don't use unlicensed content that could put the brand at legal or reputational risk.

WHO I'M LOOKING FOR

You do NOT need years of agency experience. You DO need strong instincts.

• Understand gaming culture, automotive culture, or both — from the inside

• Spend time online and get internet culture

• Spot trends before they're overused

• Can explain WHY content will perform

• Research before creating, communicate clearly, hit deadlines

• Excited to build something long-term

Bonus if you: are an active gamer or car enthusiast, have grown social accounts before, follow gaming/car/
/culture pages, or know video editing — any software.

THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

• Agencies or teams outsourcing work

• People using generic templates for everything

• People who need detailed instructions for every task

• People who can edit but don't understand culture

• People sending copy-paste applications



COMPENSATION & GROWTH PATH

Base: USD $300/month, part-time (20 hrs/week).

The raise path is real and concrete:

• After 90 days hitting agreed KPIs (consistent posting, growing engagement, early conversions) ? base rises to $500/month.

Results-Based Bonuses — I reward outcomes, not time

The bonus that matters most — Conversions (recurring):

Content that drives actual buyers, not just viewers.

• Tracked clicks to our store (your bio link / UTM, coupon code, or whatever setup you like) ? tiered monthly bonus.

• 15% of attributed sales revenue, every month — the potential is truly unlimited. For example, a phone case that sells for $40 generates a $6 commission on a single sale.

• Fair-attribution terms: paid on total revenue (not just profit).

Reach & Growth Bonuses — *quality-gated* (see rule below):

Follower Milestones (one-time): 5k ? +$50 · 10k ? +$25 · 20k ? +$50 · 30k ? +$75 · 50k ? +$100 · 100k ? +$300

Viral Videos (recurring, every video): 100k views ? +$35 · 250k ? +$75 · 500k ? +$150 · 1M+ ? +$300

Monthly Engagement (recurring): 8%+ ? +$25 · 10%+ ? +$50 · 12%+ ? +$100

THE QUALITY GATE — read this. Reach/follower/engagement bonuses only pay out if analytics confirm growth is organic and on-target: 60%+ of audience from EU/NA, with DE/AT/CH/UK/FR/NL among top countries, skewing gaming/tech/car interests. Ineligible: bought followers, bot views, giveaways/follow-loops, comment pods, or reposted third-party edits. Deleting underperformers at end of month to inflate monthly averages voids that month.

Conversion bonuses are uncapped — that's where the real upside is. Quality of audience beats raw numbers, always.

How bonuses are measured: native platform analytics + our Shopify dashboard, reviewed monthly, paid the following cycle. I'll always show you the numbers.



PAID TRIAL

Every shortlisted candidate does a paid trial. I provide product images and brand positioning.

Your task: pitch 3 short-form concepts, then deliver 1 fully finished vertical video + explain your hook strategy and reasoning for all three.

Duration: up to 1 week. Payment: USD $100, paid whether or not we continue.



HOW TO APPLY (this IS the test — most won't follow it)

Step 1 — Start your application with the word MAINFRAME as the VERY FIRST WORD. No MAINFRAME, no reply.

Step 2 — Pick ONE tribe — Gamers/Tech OR Car Enthusiasts. In 3–5 sentences, give me ONE content idea that would make that community engage, comment, and follow — and explain WHY it works. This is the most important part of your application.

Step 3 — Name ONE creator or brand whose short-form content you genuinely admire, and explain the strategy behind why it works — not just why it's cool.

Step 4 — Send 2–3 links to short-form vertical videos YOU personally edited. No agency portfolios, no team projects you didn't cut yourself.

Step 5 — Tell me your weekly availability, your rate expectations, and your editing software.

Applications that don't follow these steps will not be considered.
