The Hustler Mentality: You believe no task is too small (writing a help article) or too big (restructuring our onboarding flow).

title: Short-Form and Long-Form Video Editor — Instagram & YouTube (Part-Time, Long-Term)
description:
Hi — I’m Siobhan, founder of Envision Coaching, a women’s coaching business based in the UK. We work with women to help them permanently transform their bodies, build their confidence, and make incredible change in all areas of life.



I’m looking for a skilled, reliable video editor to join the team on a part-time, long-term basis. This is a role for someone who takes pride in their work, communicates well, and can deliver consistently without constant supervision.



THE CONTENT

You’ll be editing both short-form and long-form content. Short-form content is primarily purposed for Instagram Reels featuring me, my coaching team, clients, and events. The content typically comprises the following:



Talking-head style – Think: punchy hooks, tight cuts, on-screen captions, and editing that keeps viewers watching. This is personal brand and coaching content, not corporate or generic. Since raw content is performing well right now, we are not looking for flashy effects — we are looking for clean, intentional editing that serves the message. Almost like I could have edited it myself.



“Kitchen” reels – Me talking to camera, similar to the above but often using props. This content is typically more educational.



Promotional content – Typically to promote events that we hold periodically throughout the year. This might be a highlight of an event or photoshoot, or an announcement reel for a speaker at an upcoming event, for example.



Client interviews – Raw recordings from Zoom will be provided. It will be your job to edit the long-form version for trainings and YouTube, and take soundbites for short-form content on Instagram.



Other long-form content – VSLs for sales pages, training video edits, and occasional YouTube videos.



WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

- Editing raw talking-head footage into polished Instagram Reels (typically 30–90 seconds)

- Editing long-form Zoom recordings into clean training videos and YouTube content

- Pulling soundbites from long-form interviews for short-form Instagram use

- Editing VSLs, promotional content, and event highlight reels

- Adding on-screen captions/subtitles — accurate, well-styled, and on-brand

- Trimming for pace and retention — tight edits, no dead air

- Adding simple B-roll, transitions, or text overlays where appropriate

- Receiving raw footage and a brief via Google Drive and returning edited files to the same location

- Meeting agreed turnaround times consistently

- Communicating proactively if anything is unclear or delayed



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- Proven experience editing both short-form content for Instagram or TikTok and long-form content for YouTube or similar platforms

- Strong understanding of retention-based editing — hooks, pacing, captioning

- Experience editing Zoom recordings or interview-style footage

- Proficient in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar editing software

- Reliable, organised, and self-directed — you don’t need to be chased

- Strong attention to detail in captions and on-screen text

- Comfortable using a time tracker (Hubstaff or equivalent) — this is required

- Good written English for communication purposes



WHAT WE’RE NOT LOOKING FOR

- Heavily effects-driven editing styles — we want clean and punchy, not flashy

- Editors who cannot provide a portfolio that includes real short-form social content

- Anyone who needs constant direction — you should be able to take a brief and run with it



THE ROLE

- Part-time and long-term — this is not a one-off project

- Hourly rate: £15/hr, paid via Wise or equivalent

- Time tracking is required — you will log hours via Hubstaff or agreed equivalent

- Flexible hours — what matters is hitting turnaround deadlines, not being online at set times



HOW TO APPLY

Please include the following in your application — applications without these will not be considered:



- A link to your portfolio showing short-form Instagram or TikTok edits and at least one example of long-form work

- A brief note (3–5 sentences) on your editing approach for short-form content

- The software you primarily edit in

- Your typical turnaround time for a 60–90 second Reel



Start your application with the words ‘I have read the full job post’ so I know you have taken the time to read this carefully. Applications that don’t include this will not be reviewed.

title: All-round Digital Growth Marketer: property tech plus a new SaaS, remote
description:
All-round Digital Growth Marketer: property tech plus a new SaaS, remote



The short version

We are a European property-tech group and we need someone who can build our growth across the board. Not one channel, the whole picture: SEO and content, paid, social, AI search, influencers,
, and new international channels. You can do a bit of all of it, you go deep where it counts, and you love finding new ways to reach people. If you can prove what you have grown, read on.



Who we are

We run several live rental platforms in the European market on one shared codebase, including an established rental and property-management brand and a more modern consumer rental platform. The rental platforms are where most of our volume is today. On top of that we are launching a new in-house SaaS product in the hiring and recruitment space, which you help grow from the start. So you get both: established brands with real traffic, and a new product where you shape growth from day one.



How we work

Small team, fast pace, real ownership. We care about clear communication, good decisions, and results we can measure. We use AI tools to move faster and we expect you to do the same, as long as you check and refine before anything ships. We work async and in writing.



Your first days

1. Get our analytics and conversion tracking in solid shape, so we can actually see what works.

2. Find the quickest wins across the channels we already have, and start improving them.

3. Run the first acquisition experiments for the new SaaS product.

From there you open it up: SEO and content, paid,
 and lifecycle, social, AI search visibility, influencers, and international channels. We want someone who keeps finding new ways in, not just running the obvious ones.



What you will own over time

- The full growth picture across the rental platforms and the new SaaS: which channels we use, what we test next, and what actually moves the numbers.

- SEO and content (NL and EN): search, on-page, listings, and content that ranks and converts.

- Getting us visible where people actually look now, including AI search results and answer engines, not just Google.

- Paid where it earns its place (Google, Meta), plus
 and lifecycle automation.

- Social, brand, influencer and creative channel experiments, including international audiences.

- Analytics and simple conversion improvements on listing and signup pages, with clear reporting.



What we are looking for

- Real digital marketing experience with results you can explain, in numbers.

- Broadly skilled: comfortable across SEO, content, paid, social,
 and analytics, and able to go deep where it matters.

- A channel explorer: you have opened up or tested channels beyond the obvious ones and can show it.

- Strong written English. Dutch is a strong advantage. If you do not write Dutch, you must be comfortable managing translation and native review.

- Self-managing, reliable, and good at written async communication.

- Ideally 6 hours overlap with CET business hours, Monday to Friday. Tell us your timezone and the window you can cover.



Nice to have

- Property, real estate, or marketplace marketing.

- SaaS or early-stage product growth.

- Marketing automation or CRM, landing-page and conversion work, light design.



Rate and hours

USD per hour depending on your experience. Part-time to full-time, ideally 20 or more hours a week to start. This is a long-term role: strong work and real results move both your scope and your rate up over time and grow with results.



How we start (paid)

We begin with a small paid, time-boxed task we agree upfront, to see how you analyze, prioritize and execute on something real. No unpaid speculative campaign work, ever. If it clicks, we move into the ongoing role.



How to apply (English, no template letters)

Start the first line of your reply with: Growth that ships. Then tell us:

1. One channel you grew, with the actual result (numbers, before and after).

2. A channel or tactic you tried that most people would not think of, and how it went.

3. How you use AI tools in your work, and how you keep quality in check.

4. The two or three channels you are strongest in, and where you are still growing.

5. A link to your portfolio or one thing you are proud of.

6. Your hourly rate in USD, hours per day you can commit, your CET overlap window, and your earliest start date.



Do not apply if

- You are not the person who will do the work.

- You cannot show or explain real results.

- You only run one channel and do not want to work across the rest.

- You ship AI-generated content without checking it.

title: Assistant Buyer (Data & Procurement Specialist)
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical, detail-oriented, and fast-paced Assistant Buyer to join our procurement team. In this role, you will be the backbone of our data management, responsible for processing large volumes of supplier sheets on a daily basis. Your primary focus will be to clean, match, and analyze supplier data to ensure accurate purchasing alignment and to heavily prepare our team for vendor negotiations.

Key Responsibilities

Data Matching & Analysis: Review and reconcile massive daily supplier sheets against our current purchasing needs and active inventory.

Data Integration: Clean, format, and organize incoming vendor data, ensuring seamless integration into our internal systems.

Speed and Efficiency: Proven ability to manipulate and audit thousands of rows of data rapidly without sacrificing accuracy.



Analytical Mindset: Strong attention to detail with the ability to spot trends, pricing discrepancies, and data patterns quickly.



Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast-moving, high-pressure environment where priorities can shift daily.



Communication: Ability to clearly present data findings and summaries to the lead buyers.



Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience in procurement, supply chain, e-commerce, or retail buying.



Familiarity with inventory management software or ERP systems.



Experience writing basic macros or utilizing Google Apps Script is a plus.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume along with a brief note highlighting your specific experience managing large-scale data sets using Excel or Google Sheets.



Note: A brief practical spreadsheet assessment may be required as part of the interview process.

Our founder Kyle's journey started with a life-changing a

Edit short-form videos in CapCut/After Effects/Premiere with great pacing, text overlays, and D2C structure.

Collaborate on ideas, iterate based on feedback + performance data (CTR, conversions), and help scale what works.

Contribute to building our DTC look & feel—premium, aspirational, emotional appeal that fits supplements for serious people.



Why Join Us?



Real Impact — Your ads will directly help grow a brand people believe in. See results fast in a lean team with quick decisions.

Creative Freedom with Tools — AI multiplies your output; you bring the taste, strategy, and polish.

Flexible Remote Life — Work from anywhere in LatAm, flexible hours (with some U.S. overlap), plus an annual team retreat.

Growth Opportunity — As we scale (new products, genetic testing, omni-channel), strong performers grow with us.

Mission That Matters — We're fixing an industry full of hype with real science and transparency.



What We're Looking For



Experience with paid D2C ads (static + video) and some proven results.

Solid skills in graphic design, video editing, and tools like Photoshop, Illustrator, CapCut.

Comfort using AI in your workflow (show us examples!).

Knowledge of ad platform specs (Meta, TikTok, Amazon).

Ability to work independently and move quickly.

Strong English (written + spoken).



Portfolio should show paid ad work, variations/iterations, and how you use AI.

Not a Fit If You're only into slow brand work, pure AI generation without editing skills, or need heavy structure/long timelines.

Compensation & Details

Full-time, fully remote.

Long-term role with room to grow as we expand.



Ready to Apply?

 



Resume/CV

Portfolio link

Quick note (2–4 sentences): How do you use AI in your creative process right now? Share a real example.



We’re excited to see your work and chat about how you can help us build something people love.

Legends are Formulated.

– Kyle & The Formulated Team

Keep our file system spotless — correct folders, correct naming, nothing lost. When you apply, you'll need a codeword, and it's Lingonberry — hold onto it, you'll use it below.

Make sure every editor uploads their material to the right place, on time, following our SOPs.



Who this is for:



You're the kind of person who feels physical discomfort when a file is named "final_FINAL_v2." You read instructions to the end. You move fast but never sloppy. Your written English is clean. You want one stable, long-term home — not five clients at once.

People who skim, guess, or send the same copy-paste application to 40 jobs. This post is built to catch that, so save us both the time.

How to apply — read carefully, this is the test:



Subject line — format it EXACTLY like this:



LINGONBERRY | [years editing video] | [voiceover tool you use] | [hours/day you can overlap 00:00–23:59 CET] | [If you can work on weekends aswell]



Example: LINGONBERRY | 4 | ElevenLabs | 6 | Yes



First line of your message must answer this, in your own words: What's the last thing you localized or edited that you were genuinely proud of, and why? (One or two real sentences. Generic answers get deleted.)

Then answer these three questions — but answer them in REVERSE order (3 first, then 2, then 1):



What tools do you use for editing and for voiceover?

Describe a time a messy file system or a missed upload caused a problem — what did you do?

On a scale of "I follow the SOP exactly" to "I improvise" — where are you, and why?





Record a 60-second Loom (screen + voice). Start it by saying the codeword out loud, then show me ONE folder on your computer or drive and walk me through how you keep files organized. (This proves you can use Loom, speak clear English, and actually think about structure.)

Do not attach a generic CV. If your subject line and message are right, that's what gets you to the next round.



We read every application that follows these steps — and we ignore every one that doesn't. Looking forward to meeting the right person.

title: SMS + Phone Appointment Setter (Part-Time, Warm Leads)
description:
SALARY



$4 USD/hour base + $5 USD per qualified booked call

(~20–25 hrs/week ? $350–400/mo base; strong setters realistically earn $550–700+/mo with bookings)



TYPE / HOURS



Part-time, ~20–25 hours/week, spread across all 7 days (including weekends). Hours are on U.S. Eastern time, which means this is a night-shift role in the Philippines. Only apply if you genuinely want to work U.S. hours.





ABOUT THE ROLE



We help people in the U.S. claim their Canadian citizenship by descent. People apply through our website and give us their phone number — so every lead you contact has already raised their hand. This is NOT cold calling.



Your job is to reach these warm leads fast, by text AND phone, build trust, answer their questions, and book them into a 15-minute call with our team.



Here's the catch we need you to solve: right now, replies are piling up and leads go quiet. A lot of them are unsure if we're legit (you'll literally get "how do I know this is real?" and "your number comes up as a scam"). Text alone isn't closing the gap — we need someone who will pick up the phone, sound warm and credible, and get the call booked. The setters who win at this do both: a quick text to warm it up, then a call.



You'll work through our texting platform (SendBlue) and call from a U.S. number we provide.





WHAT YOU'LL DO





Respond FAST to inbound leads — speed is everything

Run the winning sequence: send a quick intro text, then call the lead (we'll train you on this)

Talk to leads on the phone: build rapport, answer common questions, calmly handle "is this legit?"

Qualify leads with a few simple questions (e.g., do they have a Canadian-born parent or grandparent)

Book qualified leads into a 15-minute call on our calendar

Follow up by text and call with people who went quiet

Keep the conversation list clean — no lead left unanswered

Log notes and update lead status so nothing slips







WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR





Clear, confident spoken English with a neutral accent — you'll be on the phone with cautious U.S. leads, so they need to trust your voice immediately. (This is the #1 requirement and we will assess it from your video — see below.)

Excellent written English — natural and friendly over text

Comfortable and confident making and taking phone calls (this is a phone-forward role)

Reliable and self-managing across a 7-day schedule — consistency matters more than long hours

Fast and responsive — quick replies and quick dials are what book calls

Experience with chat/SMS, phone, or CRM tools (SendBlue, GoHighLevel, HubSpot, dialers — a plus)

Available on U.S. Eastern hours, including weekends

Stable internet, a quiet place to take calls, a reliable computer, and a good headset





Bonus (not required):





Prior appointment-setting, sales, telemarketing, customer support, or live-chat experience

Experience working with U.S.-based leads or customers







COMPENSATION DETAILS





Base: $4 USD/hour for scheduled hours (~20–25 hrs/week)

Booked-call bonus: $5 USD for every qualified booked call



"Qualified" = the lead confirms a specific date/time, has a real Canadian-born parent or grandparent, and is genuinely interested. (We pay for quality bookings, not junk.)







Paid weekly or bi-weekly (your preference)

Long-term role. Reliable performers get raises and more hours.







HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY — incomplete applications are deleted)



1. Start your message with the word "MAPLE" at the very top, so I know you actually read this.



2. Record a short custom video (2–3 minutes) — THIS IS REQUIRED. No video = no consideration. In the video:





Introduce yourself on camera, speaking in English so we can hear you clearly

Tell us specifically why YOU are a good fit for THIS role — not a generic intro. Mention that it's a text + phone setting role and that you'd be calling warm leads about Canadian citizenship. Reusing an old generic VA video will be obvious; we want one made for this job.

Briefly describe any experience you have calling or texting leads, setting appointments, or doing sales/support

End with this: pretend a lead just said "How do I know this is even legit?" — say out loud, in your own words, exactly how you'd respond to keep them comfortable and move toward booking a quick call.

Upload it to Google Drive, YouTube (unlisted), or Loom and paste the link.





3. In writing, tell me: your available hours per week, and which days/times (in U.S. Eastern time) you can work.



Applications that don't start with "MAPLE" or don't include the custom video will not be reviewed.



We'll run a short paid trial with real conversations before any long-term offer. Strong setters stay on long-term.



Looking forward to hearing your voice!

title: Social Media Manager
description:
What This Role Actually Is

4ocean pulls plastic out of oceans, rivers, and coastlines, and turns the story of that work into a brand that customers want to be part of. Social media is how most of the
et us.



This role is the daily engine behind that. You take direction from the e-commerce and marketing leads and turn it into posts that go live, on time, on brand, every day. You ideate inside the strategy we set. You build the assets. You schedule the posts. You answer the comments and DMs. You boost what is working and run the simple paid campaigns we hand you. You report the numbers back honestly. This is an executor role, not a strategist role. The brand voice, the campaign themes, and the testing priorities come from us. The shipping, the polish, and the steady daily output come from you. We are not looking for someone who waits for instructions on every post. We are looking for someone who runs a calendar inside a clear playbook

and makes a hundred small, good decisions a week without needing to escalate them.



What Success Looks Like:

Three months in, the daily content engine runs without me chasing it. The calendar is full two weeks out. Posts go live when they are supposed to, formatted right for each platform, with captions that sound like 4ocean. Community responses do not pile up unread. Reporting shows up Monday mornings without being asked for, and it tells me

something I can act on.



Six months in, you are bringing me content angles and trend ideas I had not thought of, and a meaningful share of them are working. Boosted posts and the small paid campaigns you run are improving on basic metrics. You know our audience better than I do on a day-to-day level because you are living in the feeds and the comments.



What You'll Do

Organic Content Production

• Build the short-form vertical video we post to TikTok and Instagram Reels, mostly

editing from existing footage, b-roll, and creator content using CapCut, etc..

• Design static posts and carousels in Canva using the brand kit and templates we provide.

• Write captions in 4ocean's voice. We will give you examples, voice guidelines, and feedback in the first weeks until it lands consistently.

• Pitch three to five content ideas per week that connect to current trends, ocean and sustainability news, or product 
nts. We pick what ships.



Calendar, Posting, and Scheduling

• Maintain the weekly and monthly content calendar in Asana. Two-week rolling visibility minimum.

• Schedule and publish across Instagram, TikTok,
, and any new channels we add. Right format, right copy, right hashtags, right time for each platform.

• Coordinate with the e-commerce and
 teams so social posts line up with launches, promos, and lifecycle campaigns.



Community Management

• First-line responses to comments and DMs across all channels. Standard responses for FAQs, escalation to customer service or me for anything sensitive, off-script, or PR-adjacent.

• Flag negative sentiment, recurring complaints, or PR risks the same day they appear.

• Engage with creators, partners, and customers who tag us. Build the habit of conversation, not just broadcasting.



Paid Social Execution

• Boost organic posts that are earning it, using the rules we set together.

• Set up and duplicate ad sets in Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager from briefs we provide. Audiences, placements, budgets, creative uploads, naming conventions.

• Swap creative on running campaigns, refresh assets on a regular cadence, pause underperformers when they hit our thresholds.

• This is not media buying. You are not building strategy from scratch. You are running the playbook we hand you, cleanly and consistently.



Reporting

• Weekly numbers every Monday. Reach, engagement, follower growth per channel, top three and bottom three posts of the week, paid spend and basic performance against the targets we set.

• Short written commentary, two or three sentences, on what stood out and what you would try next.

• Monthly roll-up with trend notes for our review.



Who Thrives Here

Someone who:

• Treats deadlines as real and a content calendar as a commitment, not a suggestion.

• Has strong written English and can write a caption that sounds like a brand, not a translation.

• Edits short-form vertical video fast and well in CapCut. Not perfectly cinematic. Native to the platform.

• Is comfortable inside Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager from clear instructions.

• Notices things. Sees a comment trend, a competitor move, a 
 cycle, and surfaces it without being asked.

• Asks good questions early and does not let small ambiguities become missed

posts.



If you need someone to walk you through every step every day, this will not work. If you want to run a daily operation inside a clear system and grow into more responsibility as you prove it, this is the role.



Experience That Matters

• Two-plus years running social media for a brand, an agency, or a meaningful number of clients. DTC and ecommerce experience preferred.

• Portfolio showing real short-form vertical edits you have shipped, not just stock template work.

• Hands-on experience inside Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager. Not certifications. Actual campaigns you have set up and managed.

• Comfortable in Asana or a similar project management tool. We run our entire operation in Asana.

• English fluency at a level where I do not have to rewrite your captions before they go live.



Tools You"ll Use

• CapCut, etc. for video, Canva for static and carousel.

• Meta Business Suite, Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager.

• A social scheduler we will set you up in. Likely Later, Metricool, or similar.

• Asana for the calendar and task management.

• Google Drive and Slack for files and team communication.

• AI tools where they help you move faster. We will share what we use.



How to Apply:

Send a short message telling me which brands you have run social for and what your best result was. Attach two or three short-form vertical edits you made and a screenshot of a Meta or TikTok ad campaign you set up. No long cover letters.

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a brief paid trial: one reel edit from footage we provide, three caption variations, and a one-page content calendar for a hypothetical product launch. Paid at the hourly rate. Make sure to attach your updated resume link.

title: Financial Operations Specialist (Full?Time, In?House – QuickBooks Online)
description:
ABOUT PESTLAUNCH



PestLaunch helps pest control business owners build better businesses.



Most of our clients are between $300,000 and $3,000,000 in annual revenue. They are great operators, but many lack financial visibility, reporting systems, accountability, and operational structure.



Our mission is simple: Help pest control owners grow faster, become more profitable, and gain clarity in their business.



We do this through implementation, dashboards, scorecards, financial reporting, operational systems, hiring systems, and business coaching.



Unlike most consultants, we don't just tell clients what to do. We help build the systems that make it happen.



As we continue growing, we're looking for a Financial Operations Specialist to own the financial reporting layer inside PestLaunch and support multiple pest control clients through our OS.



ABOUT THE ROLE



This is not a traditional bookkeeping role.



Yes, QuickBooks experience is required.



But we're not simply looking for someone to categorize transactions or pick up a few bookkeeping clients.



We’re looking for a full?time, in?house Financial Operations Specialist who wants to:

- Manage the books for multiple companies as part of one team

- Build and follow systems and standards across all clients

- Become the internal owner of Financial Ops inside PestLaunch (not build their own separate firm)



Your job is to ensure every PestLaunch client has accurate, clean, current financial data so we can help them make better business decisions.



You will become our internal QuickBooks expert and a key part of our implementation team.



Your work directly impacts:

• Client dashboards

• Financial reporting

• Business decisions

• Profitability analysis

• Growth recommendations

• Client success



If you enjoy creating order from chaos, standardizing systems, and helping business owners understand their numbers, you'll love this role.





RESPONSIBILITIES



Client Financial Management

• Manage QuickBooks Online for multiple pest control companies

• Review and maintain accurate books across all assigned clients

• Reconcile bank and credit card accounts

• Categorize transactions correctly

• Match deposits and payments

• Maintain customer and vendor records

• Investigate and resolve discrepancies



Financial Clarity & Reporting

• Implement and maintain PestLaunch financial standards

• Standardize Chart of Accounts across clients

• Prepare monthly Profit & Loss reports

• Review Balance Sheets for accuracy

• Ensure books are current and trustworthy

• Identify unusual expenses, margin issues, reporting gaps, and inconsistencies

• Flag concerns and opportunities to the PestLaunch team



Dashboard Support

• Pull financial data from QuickBooks
